programs.title: The Story of Us With Morgan Freeman
programs.desc: Morgan Freeman seeks the answer to the question whether love can change reality.After reflection, it turns out that people organize their lives based on feelings and emotions.The documentary will show why in some cultures marriage is associated with love, while in other societies it has nothing to do with romantic ecstasy.The creators of the program wonder whether it is possible to decide on an arranged relationship despite being raised in Western culture.Morgan Freeman talks to Izidor Ruckel, Hina Belitz, William D. Swenson - an officer awarded the Medal of Honor, Dr. Samuel Tefer and homeless barber Joshua Coombes to learn as much as possible about the power common to all humanity.
